items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I left and joined Charles Elgar's band in Chicago.

ctx.x: All these places were for white people.
Is that right? That's right. And from there, I left and joined Charles Elgar's band in Chicago. I finally got home sick.
Charles Elgar. How old were you when you joined Elgar?

items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Well, we had Donald Howard, clarinet and violin.

ctx.x: I haven't heard those for several years now because I hardly ever play 78 records, but I did pick those up years ago. Who were some of the outstanding musicians in that orchestra at that time?
Well, we had Donald Howard, clarinet and violin. Joe Sutler on trumpet. We had Will, so memory doesn't function too much.
